# the paths that run .github/workflows/fuzz.yml (scripts/changed_paths.py decide)
# on.pull_request.paths of the workflow must list the same patterns in the same order
# (scripts/changed_paths.py sync)
# every file that can change a job's result is listed: a missing one skips the job on a
# change that alters it (a file a job reads that cannot change the result is not listed,
# e.g. .gitignore, which `cargo package` reads but which cannot change the packed tracked files)
src/**
# fuzz/Cargo.toml depends on the crate by `path = ".."`
Cargo.toml
# fuzz/**: the targets, fuzz/Cargo.toml, fuzz/Cargo.lock and the committed seeds the
# blocking replay runs (fuzz/ is its own workspace, so the root Cargo.lock is not read)
fuzz/**
# `cargo install cargo-fuzz` runs at the repository root, where this file picks the toolchain
rust-toolchain.toml
# the run-count reader and its test (a step of the fuzz job)
scripts/fuzz_runs.py
scripts/test_fuzz_runs.py
# the changes and gate jobs
scripts/changed_paths.py
.github/workflows/fuzz.yml
.github/paths/fuzz.txt
